summary: Security and data-handling audit of the deepCopy replacement for structuredClone and the 44 call-site replacements. Cycles terminate cleanly via the WeakMap seen-set; deepCopy survives deeper nesting than the native builtin it replaces (no DoS regression); getters, sparse arrays, null-prototype objects, shared-buffer typed-array views, DataView, and frozen sources all copy correctly; atIndex and lastIndexWhere match the native methods on a fuzz table. The 44 replacements are one-for-one with unchanged expression shape, and snapshot copies flow outward only (replay rebuilds from seed; persistence.ts never calls deepCopy), so no player or saved-game path reaches the divergent branches. Five nonblocking hardening notes, all unreachable today.
nonblocking_findings: deepCopy drops an own __proto__ data key and instead sets the clone's prototype to the copied value (probe P4/P5 in measure/runs/old_browser_builtins_20261122/probe-copy-run.mjs); structuredClone keeps it as an own data key. Unreachable from any sim state (fixed code-owned keys per the T1 pin) or save path (src/host/persistence.ts never calls deepCopy); hardening fix is one Object.defineProperty branch for the __proto__ key at src/apk3d/sim/copy.ts:73.

Symbol-keyed own properties are silently dropped (probe P11). Within the spec contract (AC1 rule 3 covers own string keys) but a divergence from structuredClone; document it or copy with Reflect.ownKeys.

RegExp values copy into objects that pass instanceof RegExp but throw TypeError on exec because the internal matcher slot is missing, and non-enumerable lastIndex is lost (probe P12). Silent data loss plus a latent crash if copied code calls the clone; no sim state holds a RegExp per the T1 type pin.
Non-enumerable own properties are dropped on every copied object (probe P8 class-instance secret field). Divergence from structuredClone; unreachable in the pinned plain-data sim states.

Cross-realm Map/Set/Date/Promise values silently flatten to {} because the instanceof guards at src/apk3d/sim/copy.ts:25-50 fail across realms (probe P14). Single-realm codebase today; becomes relevant only if a game ever runs inside an iframe.

Probe P1 self-cycle: c.self===c true; P2 Map cycle: c.get('arr')[0]===c true; P7 getter self-cycle: c.loop===c true. No infinite recursion on cyclic input.

Probe-depth.mjs: native structuredClone throws RangeError at depth 2000 while deepCopy survives to 8000; both throw at 16000. deepCopy is strictly more robust on deep nesting; no denial-of-service regression in game state copies.

Probe P6: source getter read exactly once per copy (1 read after copy 1, 2 after copy 2), matching structuredClone semantics; P9 sparse array keeps length 100 and holes; P10 null prototype preserved; P13 two views over one buffer share one new copied buffer; P16 DataView content and offsets correct; P20 frozen source unchanged after mutating the copy.

Probe P17 atIndex fuzz vs native .at over holes and indices -5..1e21 plus NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, -0, and fractions: zero mismatches. P18 lastIndexWhere vs native findLastIndex over four list shapes: all match.

git show 1dcc1043: all 44 replacements are one-for-one (35 deepCopy, 8 atIndex, 1 lastIndexWhere) with unchanged receiver, arguments, and ?? fallback shape; grep -rn 'structuredClone(' src/ returns no hit.

Reachability: src/apk3d/sim/simulation.ts:226-234 replays from the seed and never re-ingests a snapshot; src/host/persistence.ts:1-4,28-30 reads localStorage JSON of string records only and never calls deepCopy; the T1 pin (tests/old-browser/deep-copy.test.ts:110-120, green) fixes all 29 games' state type sets to plain data with code-owned keys.
